NewsArticle.Title: Uniform Vote
NewsArticle.Content: .12.12 Shall mundanes take uniforms from anyone entering Temuair who is not an official? Realize that if so, then the uniform cannot be handed to another Aisling for any reason. AT ENTRY into Temuair, if the Aisling is out of office, the uniform is taken away, no questions asked. No redress. This is the only time a mundane may effectively examine the Aisling's official status. In Mileth Inn, Riona takes your vote. In Rucesion Storage, Angelo takes your vote through 99.12.12.
